subcategory_text: Internal and external stakeholders are notified of incidents
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: IR-04, IR-06, IR-07, SR-03, SR-08
CRI Profile v2.0: RS.CO-02, RS.CO-02.01, RS.CO-02.02, RS.CO-02.03
implementation_examples: Follow the organization's breach notification procedures after discovering a data breach incident, including notifying affected customers
Notify business partners and customers of incidents in accordance with contractual requirements
Notify law enforcement agencies and regulatory bodies of incidents based on criteria in the incident response plan and management approval
assessment_objectives: Determine whether internal and external stakeholders are notified of incidents.
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that follow the organization's breach notification procedures after discovering a data breach incident, including notifying affected customers.
Determine whether activities are conducted to notify business partners and customers of incidents in accordance with contractual requirements.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
